claim_boundary: Posthoc method development after v1 full8 target results were opened. The fixed v2 source-only method and gate passed before this registration. This full8 run is a development result, not an independent validation set.

fixed_hierarchical_trust_contract.name: v1_global_trust_then_v2_local_positive_completion_v2
fixed_hierarchical_trust_contract.global_accept_action: Retain the complete v1 Bernoulli completion: p=q with binary-entropy reliability c=1-H2(q)/ln2 and raw signed scribble p/c overrides.
fixed_hierarchical_trust_contract.global_reject_action: Use only the fixed v2 local positive proposal: p=1,c=2q-1 where q>0.5; p=0.5,c=0 elsewhere; raw positive p=1,c=1 and raw negative p=0,c=1 override.
fixed_hierarchical_trust_contract.absence_policy_on_reject: Completion absence and sub-majority support have exactly zero reliability and are never interpreted as negative evidence.
fixed_hierarchical_trust_contract.fusion: One exact four-channel raster adjoint [raw positive, raw negative, c*p, c*(1-p)] followed by the frozen probability-mixture unary compiler.

completion_asset_authority.binding: Every evaluator invocation must verify its exact completion file and receipt SHA-256 before CUDA prediction.

allowed: Add one explicit hierarchical calibration mode to the existing evaluator.
Reuse the frozen v1 source-gate loader and immutable gate receipts.
On v1 rejection only, derive the preregistered local-positive p/c tensors from the already verified aggregate completion probability and raw signed scribbles.
Record the selected hierarchy branch and local-positive contract in the report.
forbidden: Change the v1 accept branch numerics.
Change the v2 majority inequality, margin reliability, or scribble overrides.
Enable graph, connected selection, diffusion, or threshold calibration.
Change field, capability cache, renderer, threshold, or benchmark protocol.
Inspect a scene target metric to change, skip, or stop later scene runs.

execution_freeze.prediction_receipt_policy: Each scene must atomically seal its candidate argv, implementation SHA, completion/gate SHA, primitive score tensor SHA, and rendered score SHA before that scene's exact target-mask open.
execution_freeze.full8_barrier_exception: A single all-eight pre-GT barrier would require retaining eight blocked CUDA evaluator processes or rerendering sealed predictions. With two GPUs this is disproportionate. The preregistered fallback is per-scene pre-GT receipts plus mandatory completion of all eight fixed runs without inspecting intermediate metrics or adapting the method.
execution_freeze.reporting_order: Do not parse or aggregate any v2 target report until all eight evaluator invocations have completed successfully.

comparison_and_reporting.primary: Full8 task-instance macro IoU versus the frozen compact macro 0.7262272301060249 and v1 hierarchical-abstention macro 0.7345068490036519.
comparison_and_reporting.secondary: Per-scene IoU delta versus each exact compact result and versus v1.
comparison_and_reporting.selection: No per-scene candidate selection from target outcomes; the hierarchical candidate is reported as one fixed method over all eight tasks.
comparison_and_reporting.promotion_is_diagnostic: Report improvement/regression counts and maximum regression, but do not alter the fixed candidate based on this development cohort.

thermal_policy.telemetry: launch and stage boundaries; additional polling only on abnormal behavior
